steps.title: At the Gate
steps.body: A traveler waits beneath the cracked archway, lantern hooded and voice low. He claims the old well has started answering back.
steps.speaker: traveling_stranger

choices.label: Follow the lantern trail
choices.summary: Move straight to the square before the glow fades.

choices.label: Question the stranger
choices.summary: Gather one more clue before committing the party.

steps.title: Inside the Inn
steps.body: The innkeeper slides a sealed scroll across the table. The knot mark on the wax matches the carving said to be hidden beneath the village well.
steps.speaker: innkeeper

choices.label: Take the scroll and head to the square
choices.summary: Arm the party with a warning before the descent.

choices.label: Warn the villagers first
choices.summary: Spend a moment preparing the square for trouble.

steps.title: The Well Answers
steps.body: The square is empty except for an old woman gripping a rope bundle. Something moves under the stones, and the well hums like a struck bell.
steps.speaker: old_village_woman

choices.label: Seal the well mouth
choices.summary: Use the rope and key to pin the iron grate in place.

choices.label: Draw the thing out
choices.summary: Break the silence and force the threat into the square.
